item.title: Leaf Reader 1.5.8
item.description:
• Rebuilt the bundled KittenTTS espeak-ng helper runtime for macOS 12.0 compatibility.
  • Added a reusable script for rebuilding the macOS 12-compatible espeak-ng and pcaudiolib runtime dependencies.
  • Kept Kokoro downloads available on older macOS versions while showing a compatibility warning below macOS 14.0.
  • Updated README and the release website to clarify app, KittenTTS, and Kokoro operating system requirements.
